name: Humor
overview: Scripture acknowledges the blessing of joy and laughter as a gift from God, exemplified in Sarah’s declaration that God made her to laugh, inviting others to share in that joy. A cheerful heart is portrayed as life-giving and healing, akin to medicine, contrasting the destructive effects of a broken spirit. Wisdom in speech is also highlighted, showing that the tongue can bring health rather than harm. Together, these verses reveal that humor and laughter, when rooted in godly wisdom, contribute to spiritual and emotional well-being.
